pages.title: Control and hearing
pages.text: Public, Trusted, Owner and Operators access restrict control, not who can hear audio.$(br2)Trusted access uses player UUIDs.

pages.title: Ownership and trust
pages.text: Access settings show the owner and trusted players.$(br2)Use online names or UUIDs to add players or transfer ownership.$(br2)Only the owner or an operator can manage these settings.

pages.title: Controller rights
pages.text: Controllers recheck the configuring player’s current target rights.$(br2)Revoked access disables their input.$(br2)Controllers cannot retain operator privileges for an Operators-only network.
